# TopologyAwareEmbedding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An embedding space that incorporates topological structure of the input data or network graph, preserving relational information for predictive tasks. Bridges TCC's topology-centric design with iNEST's predictive learning, allowing graph-based neuromorphic substrates to exploit spatial-temporal correlations in tracking.
